annotations.text:
Paribelle OMS — mobile-responsive redesign (phone only, 375×812)

Six screens ops staff reach for on a phone. Tokens, radii, shadows and type lifted exactly from globals.css / ui.tsx / app-header.tsx. Orders is now two real rails (To Ship / Cancelled & RTO), matching orders-workspace.tsx — not a generic flat list. Print-label UI is dropped throughout: the shop is read-only with the carrier.
The header's Dashboard/Orders switch + avatar menu collapse into a bottom tab bar — thumb reach beats a top target on a one-handed phone grip. Unchanged from the last round.

This is data.kind default/isQueueView from orders-workspace.tsx — OrderTable's real columns, plus the Unshipped / Packed / Shipped (24h) sub-tabs. Bulk bar keeps Mark packed / Create manifest / Undo, drops Print labels + crop toggle entirely (FEATURES.labelPrinting is effectively off here).

Top card shows the split tap target: the dashed-outline thumbnail alone opens the lightbox (see the ImageLightbox artboard); the rest of the card opens Order detail.

This is data.kind === 'cancellations' — a different component (CancellationsPanel) with different columns: status change (from → to), detected date/sync run, and the physical check-in action (Received & shelved / not returning), split by real Pending/Completed sub-tabs and the 'awaiting' vs 'ready' stages from checkInCancellation.

The 36rem centred Modal becomes a full-screen sheet (back closes it), fields go one-per-row. order-detail-modal.tsx has no action buttons in the real app — none are invented here, print-label included. The item photo carries the same tap-to-enlarge affordance as the list card.
What tapping only the thumbnail opens: image alone on a scrim, one close control, no order info. A lighter interaction than pushing the full detail sheet just to glance at the product photo.
Unchanged from the last round — already the busiest phone screen in the shop, its own full-screen route with the viewfinder given the space and Confirm/Skip in the thumb zone.
